en: Were you...one of Unos's soldiers or something<FH>
Not merely a soldier...the captain of his royal guard... When the Dreadbolt struck, I shielded him with my own body...
You saved Unos from the Dreadbolt<FG><FH>
(sigh) Would that I had been able... Alas, he was grievously wounded, and from that day onward, could fight no more...
And so, he begged the great Godbird for a boon<MV>that she would seal him and his world away, and Fractos with it...
If I had only been able to protect him better... Perhaps we would have been able to best his brother...
You shouldn't be so hard on yourself. Thanks to you, Unos survived, and our world was saved. You have nothing to be sorry for<FG>
...Thank you. (sigh) The ruins you seek are in the wilds to the north of here.
May you find what you seek there...
‘Follow the path south to reach Mt Neverest.’
‘Head north through the ruins to reach Mt Neverest.’
‘Follow the path north to reach the Beastlands. Follow the path west to reach Accordia.’
‘Follow the road north to reach the Beastlands.’
Oh, you must be the otherworlders who have come to slay Fractos<FG>
...Zounds. You are... The likeness is...<FG>
Wh-What's the matter<FH> Is there something wrong<FH>
Oh no, it is just that... The two of you look so much like Lord Unos in his younger days... Could you possibly be...<FH>
Hm. Indeed they could. Our friends here are direct descendants of your former lord and master.
I knew that you must be<FG> Not only do you look like him, but I feel the same warm light radiating from your hearts<FG>
Yes... Used in unison, that light may even be enough to sear through the bottomless blackness of Fractos's soul...
Go safely, brave warriors<FG> The ruins of your great ancestor's castle lie in the wilds to the north of here...
‘This way to the Kingdom of Klor.’
‘This way to the Kingdom of Al-Khazam.’
‘This way to the Kingdom of Kadava.’
You are the otherworlders who intend to challenge Fractos, I presume<FH>
The ruins you seek lie to the north of these frozen lands, in the north-western part of the wilds beyond.
If the way to Fractos's fortress is still intact, you will surely find it there.
Right, so north from here and then north-west<FH> Thank you. Alright, let's head for<MV>
Wait<FG> That mark on your arm<FG> Is that...<FG><FH>
(sigh) Yes, it is. I carry his blood...and his curse.
Forgive me... I meant no offence. I know only too well of the fate that befell his descendants...
I was simply...a little surprised that any of you had survived this long...
Only just. I'm the only one left...
Your kin have suffered long and hard... I pray that the coming battle frees you at last from the shackles of Fractos's sin<FG>
Go to the wilds with my blessing. Be safe.
...I'm sorry. I know I shouldn't moan. I'm sure he'd much rather be here with me on our special day than off working.
This must be the wilds. It looks just like the Beastlands, doesn't it<FH> Except dark, obviously.
The ruins of the palace should be here somewhere. I hope that the teleportal is intact...
Of course it is<FG> Come on, let's go and find it<FG>
Ah<FG> Behold, friends, something is there<FG>
Goddess be praised<FG> This is undoubtedly teleportal which we are seeking<FG>
Are you sure about that<FH> Isn't it supposed to be in a ruined palace<FH>
Well, only one way to find out<FG>
...Gah<FG> What's that<FG><FH>
Hm. I suspected we would not reach the Black Manse without a fight...
Then let's get this over with<FG> Time's running out<FG>
There's a message written on the sign...but the writing is so worn and weathered that <F4><I0>41 can't read what it says.
Hmm... Do you young whippersnappers want me to cast that spell for you<FH>
There. I think that settles the matter of where the portal leads. Why would it be so well-protected otherwise<FH>
I think you might be right. And if that's our first taste of the battles ahead, this isn't going to be easy...
Well, we don't have much choice if we're going to stop the Dreadbolt. Let's get on with it, shall we<FH>
Yeah<FG> We need to get through the portal and settle things with Fractos before it's too late<FG>
TICK-TOCK<FG><FG><FG>
Fair enough. If you ever want to turn day to night or night to day, just say the word.
Before I forget... Have you been keeping on top of your skills<FH>
You need to spend skill points to learn spells and abilities, and you'll have to assign them to buttons if you want to use them.
Oh, hello again. You've come at just the right time. I've had some cracking ideas for new weapons, but I haven't the tools to make them.
If I had the right tools, I'd be able to show the armourer how to make them so he can sell them in his store. Could you help me out<FH>
I've left a list of the stuff I need with the questmistress. If you help me, I'll make it worth your while.
Well, then... I reckon I'm about ready to head off on my travels again. Need to get the old inventive juices flowing<FG> See you around<FG>
Oh, hello<FG> There's some amazing materials out there, you know. I could make some incredible weapons out of them with the right tools...
That's where you come in<MV>you couldn't help me gather the stuff I need to make the tools again, could you<FH>
It's up to you, mind. I'll leave the details with the questmistress<MV>if you do find the materials for me, I'll make sure you're well rewarded.
Well, then<MV>it's time I was off again. If you see me out in the wilds, give us a shout<FG>
Good to see you again, <EK>00lad<EL>00lass<EM>00<FG> I've just got back from my travels in the wide blue yonder, brushing up on my smithing skills as ever<FG>
I've passed on everything I've learned so far to the armourer, and he's already put a few of my designs into production.
Go and have a look at them if you get a chance<MV>every one's a masterpiece, even if I do say so myself<FG>
Anyway, all this travelling's got me tired out. I'm gonna take a break from inventing and take it easy for a bit. I'll see you around<FG>
Blimey<FG> I never expected to see you here<FG> If this isn't destiny at work, I don't know what is<FG>
I tried to put my feet up, but I just couldn't sit still knowing there were new materials out there just waiting to be smithed<FG>
So here I am, in this other world, surrounded by the makings of otherworldly weapons<FG> But the monsters aren't keen to part with them...
The questmistress has got all the details of the stuff I need. If you can pick it up for me, I'll make it worth your while<FG>
Thank you so much<FG> If it wasn't for you, I never would have completed my life's work<FG>
Thank you<FG> I always knew you were the right <EK>00lad<EL>00lass<EM>00 for the job<FG>
Now that I've got the materials I need, I'll be able to build all the weapons I've ever dreamed of<FG>
I'll show the armourer how to go about making my designs a reality. Take a look at his stock later<MV>it'll knock your socks off<FG>
Oh, hello there<FG> As you can see, I'm out and about in search of inspiration for new ways of working metal. Now, where to next...
NOT USED
Well, well<MV>look what the cat dragged in. Here to take one of me trials, are you<FH> What'll it be today<FH>
Alright. Let's get this over with, shall we<FH>
UNUSED
Nothing takes your fancy, eh<FH> Go on, then<MV>be off with you<FG>
Fractos is looking down on us from that floating castle right now. We need to find a way to get up there...
We've got to get inside the Black Manse and take Fractos down<FG> But how are we ever going to get up there<FH>
We all heard the same voice in our dream<MV>I don't know ooze it was, but it said that you and <F4><I0>11 are actually twins<FG>
I very much doubt that Fractos will be landing his castle any time soon. If he won't come to us, then we'll just have to go to him.
A good commanding officer goes over everyone's skills each time they set out on a mission or change their party line-up.
I never thought I'd see Fractos's castle in the skies above Accordia... We need to work out how to get up there and bring it down<FG>
Jaypers... That Dreadbolt's a fearful weapon, to be sure. Nuttin' else I know of could plunge a whole world into darkness.
I've had it up to here with this world<FG> Just when we think we've won, something even worse crawls out of the woodwork<FG>
It must be even worse for you, though<MV>you poor things actually have to live here... Ahem. Not that I care or anything...
That Fractos absolutely stank<FG> He must be really, really evil<MV>nothing good could ever smell that bad<FG>
We gotta find a way to get up to that castle... Heh. If I had my trusty flying bed, Fractos would be finished already...
Hey, I just thought o' somethin'<MV>Fractos was usin' that Cup of Kings doodad to control the monsters, right<FH>
Ya don't think he mighta been the one behind the Case o' the Quittin' Critters, do ya<FH>
We heard a voice in our dreams that told us you were the twins from the prophecy, and that we must help you to fulfil it.
I can't die now<FG> I'm not even rich yet<FG> We've got to stop Fractos firing that Dreadbolt before it's too late<FG>
I wonder who brought us down from the Pinnacle of Peace before it was destroyed... Could it have been...<FH>
First he hides at the top of a tower, and now a floating castle... Something tells me our friend Fractos is fond of heights.
If only Pinnacle of Peace was not reduced to smithereens, we would be capable to leap from its utmost summit to lair of fiend<FG>
I give thanks to Goddess that all our allies escaped tower without abrasions. This outcome is most miraculous...
Maybe the Queen of Ingenia will know a way to get up to the Black Manse. Come on, let's go and see her<FG>
Alriiight<FG> When Her Majesty says she's got something to tell you, you can bet it'll be worth hearing<FG> Ingenia, here we come<FG>
The next time we see the Queen of Ingenia, I'm gooing to thank her for teaching me The Gooreat Leveller. It's super oozeful<FG>
If she sent for us especially, Her Majesty must know something crucial about the Black Manse<MV>something that will help us destroy it.
The Queen of Ingenia is a descendant of one of the seven ancient sages. Perhaps she means to share a family secret with us...
I know I must sound like an awful eejit, but I can't help worryin' we'll be thrown straight back in jail the second we walk into Ingenia...
First she taught us The Great Leveller, now she wants to tell us about the Black Manse. Her Majesty's a bit of a brainbox, isn't she<FH>
I can't wait to hear what the Queen of Ingenia's got to tell us<FG> Come on, let's go and find out<FG>
What are we waiting for<FH> Let's go find out what the Queen of Ingenia has to tell us.
So we're headin' back to Ingenia. Things've changed a whole heap since the first time we moseyed on over that way, huh<FH>
The cards also told me that we should go to Ingenia. All signs point to Her Majesty having something very important indeed to tell us...
Summoned by the Ice Queen again, hm<FH> I hope I won't be forced to fight my poor, long-suffering sis this time...
I wonder what the Queen wants to tell us<FH> Maybe she's going to teach us another spell<MV>one that will blow that castle out of the sky<FG>
Her Majesty wishes to speak to us about the Black Manse<FH> (sigh) I had hoped her business was of a more...personal nature...
Does Her Majesty intend to educate us in art of aerial perambulation, perhaps<FH> Then we are capable to stroll to fortress of Fractos<FG>
Queen of Ingenia is acquainted with secret of flight at high altitudes... Aga<FG> I pray that she is incapable to impart this wisdom to others<FG>
All those awful monsters rampaging through town... I was petrified<FG> I'm so glad you were there to save us<FG>
This beautiful city is the heart and soul of our entire world. I am grateful indeed that we were able to reclaim it safely.
You really saved our bacon<FG> But what if a band of wandering heroes isn't around to help us next time something like this happens<FH>
I'm so happy to be able to walk safely through the city once more. You've done us all a great service. Thank you.
Isn't Prince Cesar cool<FH> I wanna be just like him one day<FG>
I wish Accordia had a lovely prince like Prince Cesar...
Hmm... Our city has returned to normal. If only the same could be said for our king...
Whatever will become of Accordia now...<FH>
That man just hangs around by the stairs staring at me all the time... What does he want<FH>
I kept telling myself that I'd talk to her once the city was at peace again, but I always get cold feet at the last moment...
I've decided what I want to be when I'm older<FI> a knight<FG> I'll be big and strong so I can protect my mum and dad from anything bad<FG>
Yay<FG> Yaaay<FG> All the monsters are gone<FG> I can play outside as much as I want again<FG>
Eek<FG> ...Oh, it's you. What are you doing sneaking up on me like that<FH> For a moment there, I thought the monsters had come back<FG>
The Pinnacle of Peace may be in the same place as always, but it don't... It don't feel the same, wot wiv everyfing that's 'appened...
Now you've got rid o' them monsters, everyfing's back to normal again. We owe ya one<FG>
I'm glad things have settled down a bit here, but what about His Radiance<FH> Whatever could be going through his head<FH>
Fancy turning Accordia over to the monsters like that... I'll never trust that horrid king again<FG>
It's amazing that you were able to drive out every last monster. I just wish I had been able to help somehow...
I had no idea the High King had a twin brother<FG> Was he living here in Accordia the whole time and not a single person noticed<FH>
The monsters may have been driven out of the streets, but what of the Pinnacle of Peace<FH> If you plan to head in there, do be careful.
The sovereign twins from the prophecy...they were the High King and his brother<FH> But what does that mean<FH> What will happen to us all<FH>
Meow<FG> Meow<FG>\nPurrrrrr...
Neigh<FG>
The city may be back to normal, but I just can't relax and enjoy going shopping like I used to...
Seems them monsters took good care o' the flowers while we was gone. At least somebody out there appreciates my work<FG>
I'm a good float-o-copier, good float-o-copier<FG> Please don't beat me up, beat me up<FG>
Hmm... Are you young whippersnappers off to the Grand Dunes, then<FH>
The monsters who live there are a sight stronger than the ones in Greena Pastures. Make sure you're well prepared before you go.
NOT USED
NOT USED
Hmm... Are you young whippersnappers off to the Lumberlands, then<FH>
I've heard the forest is full of poisonous plants and venomous monsters. Take good care of yourselves out there...
NOT USED
Hmm... Are you young whippersnappers off to No Man's Land, then<FH>
It's a hellish place, where rivers of molten rock well up from underground. You'll watch your step out there if you value your health...
There are a lot of nasty monsters living in the far reaches of No Man's Land. Unless you're sure you can handle them, I'd stay well away.
Hmm... Are you young whippersnappers off to Redrock Ravine, then<FH>
The path through the canyon is very narrow, so there's no avoiding the monsters. Proceed with caution, won't you<FH>
There's an enormous locked gate in the middle of Redrock Ravine. If you find a key on your travels, you should try it and see if it fits.
Hmm... Are you young whippersnappers off to the Frosty Foothills, then<FH>
It isn't only the weather you have to watch out for up there. Some of those monsters' icy attacks can make your blood run cold too...
There are some unusual pillars in the Frosty Foothills. I heard that they have something to do with unlocking the path up Mt Neverest...
That barrier in Greena Pastures was created by an incredibly powerful monster. You'll need to be on top form if you want to defeat it.
You young whippersnappers really saved the day back there. I thought my time was up, but thanks to you, I've got a new lease of life<FG>
So you're off to climb the Pinnacle of Peace, are you<FH> I hear the layout is rather complicated. Be careful you don't get lost<FG>
So...that's the Black Manse up there, is it<FH> Is this world going to be destroyed by the Dreadbolt too<FH>
A ruined version of our world, eh<FH> I'll bet there's a fair few relics that were lost in the War of Kings still out there somewhere...
Phewee<FG> I forgot how hot the Grand Dunes could get<FG> Five minutes walking around the desert, and I'm completely pooped<FG>
I'll never get used to the heat in the Grand Dunes<FG> We'd better not hang around too long, or we'll be burnt to a crisp<FG>
Goowee<FG> The desert is sooo hot<FG> If I stay in the sun too long, I'll end up as a puddle of goo<FG>
The Dunisian forces may be regrouping for another assault as we speak. We need to make our way there as quickly as we can.
Ah now, I've sand in me sandals<FG> Not that I'm complainin', o' course<MV>it'll take more than a bit o' desert debris to stop Torneko Taloon<FG>
I can't believe we have to fight against our own army again. What the heck is Cesar thinking<FG><FH>
I can't believe we have to fight against our own army again. What in the world could have happened to make Cesar act this way<FH>
Ohhh, are we really gooing to do this again<FH> I don't want to fight your friends<MV>I want to be friends with them<FG> (slurp)
Maribel and Ruff may be small, but they seem perfectly at home on the battlefield. I'd say we've found two more stalwart allies<FG>
There I was only just gettin' used to bein' a visitor from another world, and now two chisellers from a whole 'nother one show up<FG>
What the heck was Cesar thinking<FH> He only ever acts like that when he's angry<MV>but what's he got to be angry about<FH>
Something awful must have happened to make Cesar so angry. If we're ever going to get to the bottom of this, we'll need to find out what.
I hope the Prince of Dunisia's okay... You should goo and see him<MV>we'll stay out here and guard the city until you come back.
Prince Cesar's hearing is to be held in the throne room at the very top of the Pinnacle of Peace. Let's head up there, shall we<FH>
I'll wait down here if ye don't mind at all, at all. Here's hopin' the High King ain't too hard on yer wee friend...
I'd like to know what that silly prince was so angry about. Did his maid forget to polish his crown or something<FH>
I don't think Prince Cesar's a proper baddie. He definitely didn't smell like one...
If we want to find out who killed Cesar's dad, it seems like Ingenia's the place to be. Come on, we've got to get through that forest<FG>
It seems like going to Ingenia's our best bet if we want to find out who assassinated the King of Dunisia. We need to set out right away<FG>
Gooray<FG> I love forests<FG> They're so cool and shady, I don't have to worry about melting into a puddle<FG>
Having grown up in the heat of the desert, the cool of the forest always feels...strange to me. I doubt I will ever get used to it.
Some of the monsters in the Lumberlands take a bit of getting used to. But you'll need to get used to them if you're going to survive.
So this Ingenia place is ruled by a queen, ye say<FH> We've one o' those back in my world. I've not the happiest memories of it, if I'm honest...
Doesn't Torneko get tired lugging all that junk around with him all the time<FH> It's making my back hurt just looking at him<FG>
I saw some really tasty-looking mushrooms in that forest<MV>bright red ones with lovely white spots<FG> They're edible, right<FH> ...Right<FH>
The Queen of Ingenia's got a lot of nerve, locking us up like that. She'd better have a good reason for it, or she'll be sorry<FG>
Why would the Queen of Ingenia have us arrested<FH> We've got to go and see her and find out what in the world is going on<FG>
<F4><I0>01... You don't think the Queen of Ingenia might be a...baddie, do you<FH> (quiver)
Her Majesty thinks she can escape justice by throwing us in her dungeons<FH> She has only delayed the inevitable. Justice will be done<FG>
It's not the first time I've been jailed fer a crime I didn't commit, ye know. Thank heavens me auld pal Meena came along when she did<FG>
We traipse all the way through that horrible forest to get to Ingenia, and THAT'S how they welcome us<FG><FH> Where are their manners<FG><FH>
I can never tell if Cesar's happy or angry. It's that funny chuckle he does. Hmph<FG> No... Hurf<FG> No... Ahhh, I give up<FG>
So the Queen doesn't wanna play nice, huh<FH> Then we better get nasty<FG>
I been scratchin' my head tryin' to figure how come we got locked up, but all's it's gotten me is a sore scalp<FG> Better go ask the Queen<FG>
You want to know what my sister is like<FH> Well...she looks very much like me...but on the inside, we are different. Very different...
The Queen of Ingenia's pretty convincing, but how much of what she said was actually true<FH> I hope the High King can help us figure it out...
I just don't know who to believe any more... Well, apart from the High King<MV>if we can trust anyone's judgement, it's his.
Terry, Carver, Meena, Maya... Hee hee<FG> If we meet any more new friends, I'm gooing to run out of tentacles to count them on<FG>
If Her Majesty is telling the truth, then who killed my father<FH> That seer she spoke of could be the culprit...if he even exists.
Come on, it's time for the Queen of Ingenia's audience with the High King. These royals don't like to be kept waiting, you know<FG>
Somethin' tells me yer wan the Queen's not spinnin' a yarn. Which means this black-robed fella's still out there somewhere...
Meena and Maya might look the same, but their personalities are completely different. Unluckily for poor Meena...
If Maya taught me, d'you think I'd be able to dance like she does<FH> Cor, that'd be brilliant<FG>
This guy in the black robe... Something tells me he might have had something to do with the monsters going missing from the Wildwood...
The High King's the wisest guy in the world, right<FH> If he can't figure this whole mess out, I'll buy myself a hat and then eat it<FG>
I will explain everything to my sister. You should go to the Pinnacle of Peace to hear what the High King has to say.
Pass on my best wishes to the Queen, won't you<FH> I'm off to have a look around town<MV>there must be a casino here somewhere...
We've got to keep fighting. If we don't, this war's never going to end<FG>
We have to fight<FG> It may sound ridiculous, but it's the only way to restore peace<FG>
(quiver) I'm n-n-not afraid...I'm quivering with excitement<FG> Now's the perfect chance to show the fruits of my training<FG>
It's not the size of an army that wins a war, but its mobility. On the battlefield, if you stand still for an instant, you're as good as dead.
The war has already begun. And there's only one way it's going to end<MV>with our victory<FG>
I've been in more scrapes in me time than a rusty razor, but I've never found meself in the middle of a full-blown war before<FG>
Ugh, where are all those monsters COMING from<FG><FH> It seems like the more of them we beat, the more of them attack us<FG> It's not fair<FG>
Aoooooo<FG> I'm going to fight with all my might so we can end this stupid war and everyone can be friends again<FG>
The King of Al-Khazam must be a real big shot to have an army that big. Can't wait to cut him down to size<FG>
Ain't nothin' to it<MV>we just gotta fight, fight an' fight some more till there ain't no more fight left in 'em<FG>
We may not want to fight, but we have no choice. If we all work together, perhaps we can bring back peace soon.
The more monsters the merrier, I say<FG> I'll soon work my magic on them, and blast them all to kingdom come<FG>
I've always thought snow must be like shiny white sand<MV>why didn't anyone tell me it's freezing cold<FG><FH>
The Frosty Foothills look so pretty with all that sparkling snow everywhere, it almost makes you forget what a hostile place it is...
Goowee<FG> I've never seen so much snow before in my whole life<FG> Just imagine how many snow-slimes we could build<FG> (slurp)
Do I feel the cold<FH> Ha. You forget that you are speaking to a Prince of Dunisia. ...Of course I do.
Mt Neverest has been revered as a sacred peak since ancient times. Only those deemed worthy are allowed to climb it.
So we're away across a massive snowfield to climb the tallest mountain in the world, eh<FH> Sure, an' nothin's ever easy now, is it<FH> Heh<FG>
Whose bright idea was it to hide the legendary weapon on the top of a mountain<FH> It's almost as if they don't WANT us to find it<FG>
Urrrgh... I don't know why, but running around in the snow has made me feel even hungrier than I usually do...
The cold makes monsters tough. So we gotta be tougher.
...You what now<FH> Am I cold<FH> Har har<FG> You kiddin' me<FH> I been dressin' this way since forever<FG> I'm A-okay whatever the weather<FG>
I cannot bear the heat, but the cold does not bother me. Of course, for my sister, it's completely the other way round.
Oh, Goddess...why do the foothills have to be so frosty<FG><FH> By the time we reach the top of Mt Neverest, I'll be frozen solid<FG>
I really loved seeing all that snow at first, but it doesn't half get boring after a while...
I was so excited when I first saw all that snow, but having trudged up half a mountain's worth of it, summer can come any time it likes<FG>
I hope everybody in the Gooreat Divide is doing okay... Look lively, soldier<MV>our comrades are counting on us<FG>
How Desdemona can brave the snows of Mt Neverest dressed like that, I don't know. Does she not feel the cold<FH>
Mt Neverest is a mystical place. Some say that it's so close to the heavens that the spirits of the dead sometimes get confused...
Climbin' mountains ain't the job fer me. It's alright for racin' snakes such as yerselves, but there's a lot more o' me to haul up, so<FG>
I've seen enough snow to last me a lifetime. Let's just get to the top of the mountain, find that weapon and never go back there again<FG>
Hey, I've just had a thought<MV>can you eat snow<FH> Climbing mountains makes me really hungry, so if I could eat on the way up...
We're against the clock here, remember<FH> Quit wasting time. We got a legendary weapon to find.
Sloggin' up them slippery slopes sure takes it outta ya, huh<FH> Let's just get up there, get that weapon and get gone<FG>
The weapon we seek must be amazingly powerful. Why else would it be hidden somewhere so hard to reach<FH>
Mt Neverest<FH> Arey, Mt Give-Me-A-Break, more like<FG> If we don't find this legendary weapon soon, I swear I'll freeze to death<FG>
So, there's a legendary weapon on the top of that mountain, is there<FH> Then what are we waiting for<FH> Let's go and get it<FG>
So I have been transported to another plane with my dearest Jessica. Well, she will have that effect on a man...
From a snowy mountain to a burning desert and back again, eh<FH> Do you think the chilblains are part of the trial<FH>
